title: ชุดการจัดกิจกรรมการเรียนรู้ ภาษาไทย ชั้นมัธยมศึกษาปีที่ 1 ภาคเรียนที่ 1
notes: Office of the Basic Education Commission / IPST teacher guide, p. 5. The page describes ฤ ฤๅ ฦ ฦๅ as syllabic units broadly corresponding to ริ/รึ/รือ/ลึ/ลือ. This supports orthographic/lexical scope, not a universal IPA rule.

title: คู่มือการสอนอ่านเขียน โดยการแจกลูกสะกดคำ
notes: Office of the Basic Education Commission teaching guide, section 2.9 (printed p. 275): explicitly lists อ นำ ย examples อย่า, อยู่, อย่าง, อยาก. Supports this lexical family, not a productive rule for arbitrary spellings.

title: A Reference Grammar of Thai
notes: Iwasaki and Ingkaphirom; reference coverage includes aspect, pragmatic particles, relative clauses, question formation, passive/causative constructions and word structure. Motivates candidate categories only; not per-token gold annotations.

title: Thai: An Essential Grammar (3rd edition)
notes: David Smyth; reference coverage includes classifiers, sentence particles, negation, questions, time and speech conventions. Supports category selection, not automatic contextual adjudication.

title: Nominalizations and its grammaticalization in standard Thai
notes: Aliang Li, Folia Linguistica 58(2):291-326. DOI 10.1515/flin-2024-2006; discusses การ, ความ and การที่ nominalization strategies. Contextual evidence only; no redistribution of source data.

title: The (post-)syntax of repeater classifiers: A case study in Thai
notes: Éva Dékány, Journal of Linguistics. Shows Thai repeater classifiers require structural treatment; supports deferring classifier/reduplication claims from simple token rules.
